name: Discord
layout_summary: Far-left strip: server icons (Discord logo at very top for DMs). Second column: channels or Direct Messages list, with user profile/mic/headphones bar at bottom-left. Center: active chat history and 'Message @name / #channel' input box at the bottom.
avoid_traps: In Quick Switcher (ctrl+k), NEVER pass press_enter=true when typing a contact name (React takes ~400ms to filter, so immediate Enter jumps to the wrong server!). Instead, call type_text(contact_name, press_enter=false) without '@', let the filtered dropdown appear in the screenshot, and then use smart_click to click the matching Direct Message user row.
Top header contact/channel name is display-only — do NOT click it once inside chat.
If the target contact is already visible in the left Direct Messages sidebar (or Previous Channels), just smart_click their name directly instead of opening Quick Switcher.
Do NOT click the voice call or video call icons at top-right when you only want to send a text message.

quick_switcher.primary: press_key('ctrl+k') -> type_text(target_name, press_enter=false) -> smart_click('matching row in Quick Switcher results')
quick_switcher.visual_fallback: smart_click('Find or start a conversation button at top of left sidebar')
quick_switcher.verify: Quick Switcher modal filters results and clicking the matching entry opens the target DM/channel

open_dm.primary: If contact is visible in Direct Messages sidebar, smart_click('<name> in Direct Messages sidebar'). Otherwise: press_key('ctrl+k') -> type_text(contact_name, press_enter=false) -> smart_click('<name> Direct Message row in Quick Switcher results')
open_dm.visual_fallback: smart_click('Discord logo at top-left to open Direct Messages') -> smart_click('<name> in Direct Messages sidebar')
open_dm.verify: Chat view switches to the target Direct Message (@username) conversation, not a server channel

send_message.primary: smart_type('Message input box at bottom of chat', message_text, submit=true)
send_message.verify: Message appears at the bottom of the chat history

toggle_mute.visual_fallback: smart_click('Mute microphone icon at bottom-left next to username')

toggle_deafen.visual_fallback: smart_click('Deafen headphones icon at bottom-left next to microphone')

search_in_channel.verify: Top-right search bar is focused with channel/DM filter

mark_read.verify: Unread indicators in the current channel are cleared
